## Summary
Implement OCR enrichment for lecture slide images using Haiku Vision as the primary extractor and tesseract as fallback, appending extracted text to the corresponding LectureSection.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want text from diagrams, charts, and images in my lecture slides to be automatically extracted, so that the knowledge graph captures all content — not just typed text.

## Why this matters
Medical lectures are heavily visual: anatomy diagrams, pathology slides, pharmacokinetic charts. Without OCR enrichment, up to 40% of lecture content (embedded in images) is invisible to the pipeline. This directly impacts SubConcept completeness and assessment quality.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Images from LectureSection.image_urls sent to Haiku Vision for text extraction
- [ ] Haiku Vision prompt uses sanitizeForContext (Rule 5) and HAIKU_MODEL constant (Rule 4)
- [ ] Tesseract fallback triggers when Haiku Vision fails or returns empty
- [ ] Extracted OCR text appended to lecture_sections.raw_text (with `[OCR]` prefix delimiter)
- [ ] Supabase updated FIRST with OCR text, then Neo4j node property updated (Rule 6)
- [ ] Batch image processing uses Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] All Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] OCR prompt committed to packages/ai/prompts/ocr.md
- [ ] Cost per image stays under $0.01 (Haiku Vision pricing)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/ocr-enrich.ts
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants'
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse'
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

export async function ocrEnrich(sections: LectureSection[], institutionId: string) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    sections
      .filter(s => s.has_images)
      .flatMap(section =>
        section.image_urls.map(async (imageUrl) => {
          try {
            // Primary: Haiku Vision
            const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
              model: HAIKU_MODEL,
              messages: [{
                role: 'user',
                content: [
                  { type: 'image', source: { type: 'url', url: imageUrl } },
                  { type: 'text', text: sanitizeForContext(ocrPrompt) }
                ]
              }],
              max_tokens: 1024,
            })
            const { data } = safeJsonParse<{ text: string }>(response.content[0].text)
            return { sectionId: section.id, text: data?.text || '' }
          } catch {
            // Fallback: tesseract
            return { sectionId: section.id, text: await tesseractFallback(imageUrl) }
          }
        })
      )
  )

  // Update Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  for (const result of results) {
    if (result.status === 'fulfilled' && result.value.text) {
      await supabase
        .from('lecture_sections')
        .update({
          ocr_text: result.value.text,
          ocr_status: 'completed',
        })
        .eq('id', result.value.sectionId)
    }
  }

  // Update Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
  // ... neo4jQuery calls
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S03.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S03: OCR enrichment', () => {
  test('OCR enrichment appends text to sections with images', async ({ request }) => {
    // Pre-condition: lecture with image sections must exist
    // This test assumes E03-S02 test data is available
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/sections`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      const imageSections = data.filter((s: any) => s.has_images)
      for (const section of imageSections) {
        // After OCR, sections with images should have ocr_text
        if (section.ocr_status === 'completed') {
          expect(section.ocr_text).toBeTruthy()
          expect(section.ocr_text.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('OCR gracefully handles sections without images', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/sections`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      const textOnlySections = data.filter((s: any) => !s.has_images)
      for (const section of textOnlySections) {
        // Sections without images should not have ocr_text
        expect(section.ocr_status).not.toBe('completed')
      }
    }
  })

  test('Negative: invalid image URL triggers tesseract fallback', async ({ request }) => {
    // This test verifies the fallback path
    // In CI, we would mock Haiku Vision to fail and verify tesseract is called
    expect(true).toBe(true) // Placeholder — requires mock infrastructure
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `ALTER TABLE lecture_sections DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS ocr_text; ALTER TABLE lecture_sections DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS ocr_status;`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (ls:LectureSection) REMOVE ls.ocr_enriched`
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
